Margaret Brading paints a bowl during Empty Bowls Naples' monthly public painting party on Sunday, Aug. 5, 2018. Empty Bowls is an independent all-volunteer nonprofit organization celebrating its 13th year, with a mission to create awareness and raise funds to eliminate hunger one bowl at a time. Each bowl is made and fired by a local potter, while participants sign up in advance to attend a painting party to decorate a bowl. The Empty Bowls event held each January in Cambier Park supports a community effort to feed the nearly 40,000 people in Collier County who are food insecure.

Our three boys (Grant, 8 years old & Cooper and Lance, 2 year old twins) worship the ground their dad walks on. They follow their dad everywhere! As a &#x201C;boy mom&#x201D;, I don&#x2019;t feel like an outsider, but rather watch in utter amazement that I was lucky enough to marry this man. Darin is an authentic example of the true meaning of family values. He is an extremely hard worker and travels for work but when he is home, he is 100% committed to making sure our family time is about quality, not just quantity. I never take for granted that my husband considers it a blessing to teach our sons how to grow into great men someday. Darin has never complained, doesn&#x2019;t golf, and doesn&#x2019;t need &#x201C;his&#x201D; time because he knows his time to make difference in his sons&#x2019; lives is NOW. That is true &#x201C;hotness&#x201D; in a man!
